# Zen Typer

> Zen Typer is a free typing app that runs entirely in the browser. Quote Mode is a typing test on short passages from public-domain books, with live WPM and accuracy. Zen Mode is an open writing canvas. There is no account and no server; settings, stats, and drafts stay on the device.

Zen Typer is built and maintained by Jonathan R. Reed. It is meant for typing practice without a leaderboard or a timer counting down at you.

## What it does

- Quote Mode: 322 quotes from 22 writers, every one from a public-domain edition with its source named. The clock starts on the first keystroke and stops on the last character. Backspace rewinds to the earliest uncorrected mistake. The result shows WPM, accuracy, and mistakes grouped as wrong keys, skips, and extras. The pool can be filtered by length and by tag, and custom text can be pasted in.
- Zen Mode: free-flow typing where each finished word drifts up the canvas. Everything typed is saved as a draft that can be reopened, copied, or exported as Markdown. An optional timed flow of 5 to 60 minutes ends with a summary.
- Progress: a calendar of practice days, the current streak, best WPM, average accuracy, and the last 500 sessions.
- Sound, off by default: six synthesized keyboard switch profiles and four ambient beds (rain, wind, fire, drone), generated with Web Audio at runtime. No audio files are downloaded.
- Themes: Void, Cosmic, Aurora, Ocean, Glacier, Forest, Ember, Sakura, built on the Rosé Pine palette. Each has a WebGL2 ambient scene that freezes under reduced motion.
- Backups: one JSON file exports settings, stats, history, and drafts; the same file restores them on another device. Stats can be reset and all data deleted from settings.
- Phones: Quote Mode works with on-screen keyboards and composed input.

## How it is built

Astro 7 renders static pages. The interactive parts are React 19 islands. Styling is Tailwind over CSS variables holding the Rosé Pine tokens. Settings and stats are in localStorage; drafts are in IndexedDB through Dexie. The source is on GitHub under the MIT license.

- [Astro](https://docs.astro.build/)
- [React](https://react.dev/)
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs)
- [Rosé Pine](https://rosepinetheme.com/)
- [Bun](https://bun.sh/docs)
